title: HC-DTO: Human-Centric Digital Twin Orchestration for Industrial Cyber-Physical Systems
description: Seeded discrete-event simulator of human-centric digital twin orchestration for industrial cyber-physical systems, with the experiment grid (scalability, workload, node failures, ablation, operator proficiency), multi-objective non-dominance analysis with paired 95% confidence intervals, raw per-trial results, and scripts that regenerate all figures and tables.
